preferences.languageDesc: Choose the default console language. Changes apply immediately after saving.
preferences.languageZhDesc: For domestic teams and Chinese workflows.
preferences.languageEnDesc: For global teams and English workflows.
preferences.themeDesc: Choose the console color mode. Changes apply to the current account after saving.
preferences.themeLightDesc: Use the light interface for daytime and bright environments.
preferences.themeDarkDesc: Use the dark interface for nighttime and low-light environments.
preferences.themeSystemDesc: Follow the current device system theme automatically.
preferences.timeZoneDesc: Controls localized time display across the console. When unset, it follows the browser time zone: {{timezone}}.
preferences.timeZoneFixedDesc: Always display console time in this time zone.
preferences.lowBalanceDesc: Receive alerts when balance falls below the threshold so API access is not interrupted.
preferences.saveError: Failed to save preferences. Please try again.
